alert.title: Google started blocking searches
alert.detail: social/Google searches failed or were blocked on 2 venues in a row (CAPTCHA?). Run run-20261001-0109 resumes next night. If it keeps happening, open Chrome and solve the Google check once.

runs.outcome: stopped: social/Google searches failed or were blocked on 2 venues in a row (CAPTCHA?)

night.note: No scraper fix was needed tonight: all three things the pipeline missed (the Ritz-Carlton Residences GM, the Stella Notte owner and its catering@ email) were off the venues' own websites, and Google's captcha blocked the searches that might have found them; the taste review logged 4 votes, added Talbot Country Club, The Ivy Hotel and The Inn at Henderson's Wharf to the favorites, and needed no scoring changes.
